thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: p99 latency breach detected for customer MonolithCorp (dedicated pool: monolith-eu-west) — sustained >3x SLO for 5m. Auto-escalation: paging on-call.

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-8842. Severity: P1. Runbook: dedicated-pool-latency. On-call: emma.

emma (oncall): I'm up. pulling graphs now. Can someone paste the p95/p99 timeline?

raj (infra): grabbing heap of metrics from metrics-store. Quick snapshot: p95 ~420ms (baseline 120ms), p99 ~1.8s (baseline 380ms). Token throughput normal. Error rates = nominal.

marta (sre): Noting region: eu-west-1. Affected model variants: gpt-rlhf-large-quant and gpt-rlhf-large-int8. Traffic origin: 98% from MonolithCorp VPC endpoints (tenant prefix monolith-*) — looks tenant-localized.

samir (prod-eng): Confirming MonolithCorp saw timeouts in their app stack, they reported via account team. Lina, Caroline - you're on the thread?

lina (account-eng): Yep, received customer report at +1. They see 500ms+ latencies on interactive features. They've escalated to their SRE. Asking for ETA.

caroline (ps): Providing context — MonolithCorp uses a dedicated pool with 6 instances, pinned to faster models. They run bursty inference (plotting shows large multi-request bursts at minute boundaries).

ops-automation: Auto-check: pool utilization = 98%, queue length = 42 requests, avg runtime per request = 1.2s. KV cache hit-rate 12% (low).

emma (oncall): Hypothesis: one heavy tenant or misbehaving job saturating pool. First action: identify top tenants by RPS and isolate if single noisy tenant. Raj, can you run tenant topk?

raj (infra): Running: `rwdctl telemetry top-tenants --pool monolith-eu-west --window 5m --metric rps`

raj (infra): Output (top 6): monolith-frontend (62% RPS), analytics-batch (27% RPS), other tenants <5%. analytics-batch looks suspicious — batch job started ~10:12 UTC.

marta (sre): analytics-batch = MonolithCorp internal analytics (same customer) — interesting, it's the same org but different tenant id. If we evict or throttle that tenant we should reduce tail latency for interactive tenants.

emma (oncall): Agreed. Prepare a soft-throttle first to avoid data loss. Run tenant throttle to 20% for analytics-batch. Command: 

```
# soft throttle
rwdctl tenant throttle --tenant analytics-batch --pool monolith-eu-west --rate 0.2
```

raj (infra): Executing throttle now.

ops-automation: Throttle applied. analytics-batch limited to 20% of previous concurrency. New queue length = 8.

marta (sre): Observing metrics: p99 dropped from 1.8s -> 860ms in 30s. p95 -> 260ms. Still above SLO but trending down.

samir (prod-eng): Customer is still seeing degraded UX but improving. Recommend isolating analytics-batch to its own smaller pool for long-term, but for now can we evict it or move to warm spare?

emma (oncall): Two parallel actions: 1) If throttle doesn't recover p99 under 600ms in 2m, evict analytics-batch (eviction moves in-progress requests to retry) — high-risk. 2) Bring up 2 spare instances in pool as emergency scale to buy time. Raj, can you spin spares?

raj (infra): Spawning 2 instances: `rwdctl dedicated scale --pool monolith-eu-west --add-instances 2 --reason "INC-2026-8842 emergency scale"`

ops-automation: Scale request accepted. New instances provisioning started (expected 90s).

marta (sre): Also enabling temporary routing fallback: small fraction (5%) of interactive traffic to eu-west-2 warm spare region for MonolithCorp if latency > 800ms. Command: 

```
routingctl set-fallback --customer monolithcorp --primary eu-west-1 --fallback eu-west-2 --threshold 800ms --pct 5
```

raj (infra): Fallback configured; checking network ACLs with MonolithCorp VPC peering — allowed.

lina (account-eng): Looping in customer contacts: Monolith SRE notified; they asked for ETA on full recovery. I'll tell them we're doing throttling + emergency scale and will update in 3m.

caroline (ps): Quick ask: any chance batch job triggers are cron-aligned? We can suggest customer move batch off peak. For now, can we snapshot request id pattern and share to them.

emma (oncall): Good call. Raj, dump top request samples to pastebin.

raj (infra): `rwdctl telemetry dump-requests --pool monolith-eu-west --filter tenant=analytics-batch --limit 20 > /tmp/analytics-sample.log` — uploaded to internal paste: https://internal.paste/abcd1234

marta (sre): p99 now 620ms, p95 210ms, queue length 4. New instances should be up in ~40s. Recommend waiting 60s to see stable numbers before evicting.

ops-automation: New instances healthy and joined pool (2 instances). Pool capacity +33%. Queue drained to 0.

emma (oncall): Nice. Observability check: token-level cost unaffected. KV cache hit-rate still low — consider prewarming for interactive model. For now mitigation succeeded.

samir (prod-eng): MonolithCorp confirms latency back to acceptable levels on their side (chat features responsive). Lina, update customer with rollback of throttle and note suggested configuration changes.

lina (account-eng): Will do. Sending update: "We've throttled internal analytics workload and added emergency capacity; we'll follow up with recommended tenant isolation and scheduling changes."

caroline (ps): Next steps we should propose in post-incident: - Create a dedicated small batch pool for MonolithCorp - Add rate-based auto-isolation when a tenant >50% RPS for >3m - Improve KV prewarm for interactive variants - Run customer-facing RCA with timeline.

emma (oncall): Agreed. For now I'll mark incident as mitigated, but keep the thread open for RCA. Pagerduty: set status to acknowledged -> mitigated.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-8842 status: mitigated. Recording timeline and actions.

ops-automation: Created follow-up ticket: OPS-6442 "MonolithCorp: dedicated batch pool + tenant isolation policy" and scheduled sync with account team tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

marta (sre): Adding note: we did a soft throttle then emergency scale; no eviction required. No customer data loss reported.

emma (oncall): Handoff: I'm going offline in 20m; Samir will own the postmortem and follow-ups. @samir please confirm.

samir (prod-eng): Confirmed. Will lead RCA and coordinate with Lina/Caroline for customer comms.

lina (account-eng): Thanks all. I'll set up a call with MonolithCorp SRE for root cause and suggested changes.

emma (oncall): Closing now — will add final metric snapshots to OPS ticket. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Note: thread archived to INC-2026-8842.
